## The claim

Fold-over B-deviation detects a mosaic gain at a materially lower cell fraction than the mean B-allele-fraction statistic entry 037 used, on identical simulated sites.

**Prediction if true.** Run through the same mixing harness on the same heterozygous-site histograms, the fold-over statistic's 80-percent-power fraction is at least 1 percentage point below the mean-BAF statistic's on a majority of autosomes.

**What would refute it.** The two limits agree within 1 percentage point on most autosomes -- entry 037 was not underpowered, and the re-test's contribution is confirmation rather than correction.

## Evidence

Nothing observed yet. This claim is proposed, not tested.
